purpose: UI-facing readiness contract for source-backed non-appearance commercial options and packages, preserving exact configuration applicability, prices, package composition and evidence boundaries.

scope.included: Active non-appearance commercial options and packages that already have explicit master mappings to configuration_code.
excluded: Six Spring exterior-colour commercial items; appearance choices are owned by the configurator appearance artifacts.
Any inferred option, package, compatibility rule, conflict or dependency not explicitly supported by repository evidence.

ui_contract.selector_source: Use commercial_item_configurations rows with availability_status=optional as the selector offer layer and join commercial_items by commercial_item_code.
ui_contract.composition_source: Use commercial_item_attributes to render package contents or the semantic feature represented by a standalone option.
ui_contract.price_semantics: A blank amount is unknown/not stated, never zero. Currency alone does not imply a zero-price option.
ui_contract.selected_observation_semantics: Rows with availability_status=standard that were added from exact stock evidence are selected-state observations, not duplicate selector offers.
ui_contract.absence_semantics: Do not infer global unavailability from a missing mapping unless the upstream source scope is explicitly complete for that configuration.
ui_contract.combination_semantics: Do not claim that arbitrary simultaneously selected commercial items are orderable together unless exact source evidence or an explicit dependency/conflict rule proves the combination.
ui_contract.total_price_semantics: Base price plus one individually priced mapped choice may be shown as arithmetic. A multi-choice total must be labeled provisional unless compatibility/orderability is source-verified.
ui_contract.appearance_boundary: Exterior colours, wheels and upholstery remain in the separate appearance contract. Do not merge Spring colour commercial items back into the commercial selector.
ui_contract.exact_scope_boundary: Never transfer an item mapping across grade, powertrain, transmission, drive, seat count, phase or model identity.

known_special_cases.rule: The master mapping is intentionally limited to the modeled automatic configuration because ACC is part of the package and the source condition ties ACC availability to an automatic gearbox.

Four exact-stock selected-state rows duplicate separately priced selector offers for Parking/Winter Plus on two automatic Eco-G 120 configurations. Preserve selected-state evidence but deduplicate these rows from the offer selector.
Five valid offer mappings have no captured amount: Type 2 cable for three grades, Techno package for Expression and DC 40 kW option for Expression. UI must show price as unknown/not stated.

next_data_gap.name: commercial_choice_combination_rules
next_data_gap.description: A generic dependency/conflict/orderability graph for simultaneous package and option selection is not represented in the current master schema. Exact source evidence may prove isolated combinations, but it must not be generalized.
